No unrelated refactors or extra features; the only extra behavior is the accepted-invite deletion inside sendInvite (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:78-80), which is small and related.

issues.explanation: confirmRemoval() and cancelRemoval() are public Livewire actions that change component state without any server-side authorization, violating the project's rule that every public action authorizes, even though the impact is currently limited to the confirmation flag.

selectedMembershipId is a client-writable record ID and confirmingRemoval a client-writable flag without #[Locked], so a tampered payload can set them directly; the scoped queries and entity authorization limit the impact, but the Livewire security policy requires locking server context.

saveRole() replaces the old membership-scoped $this->authorize('assignRole', $membership) with only authorize('update', $this->entity); if the assignRole ability encoded stricter rules, this widens who may change roles, and no test covers the difference.

The 'unique-constraint race' test never triggers the unique violation: the expired row is deleted normally and the second sendInvite is rejected by the pending check before the try block, so the QueryException catch at app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:89-93 is not exercised despite the test's comments claiming it forces the collision.
The component validates with inline $this->validate([...]) rules instead of the #[Validate] attributes the project's Livewire pattern prescribes.
Invite creation and membership acceptance are domain writes performed directly in Livewire components instead of the app/Actions/* classes the conventions require.

The invite e-mail input is a raw <input> with only a placeholder (the previous code used <x-input>) and has no label or aria-label, so it is less accessible than the surrounding Bulma forms and the tests do not assert an accessible name.

sendInvite also deletes accepted invites (whereNotNull('accepted_at')) in addition to expired ones, which the task does not allow and which silently removes the invite history; only an expired invite should be replaced.

The catch converts every QueryException, including connection or other database failures, into a duplicate-invite validation error, masking real failures instead of only handling unique-constraint violations.

openMember() prefills memberRole with the current role, but for the owner that value is 'owner' while the select only offers admin/employee, so the owner's modal shows no selected role option and Save then returns 403.
openMember() aborts with 404 on a foreign ID before clearing selectedMembershipId, so when a member was already selected the previous one stays selected instead of the required 'select nothing'.

The 'pending' predicate is duplicated in three queries while EntityInvite::isPending()/isExpired() (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:50-58) exist but are only used in tests; a local scope would keep the definition in sync.

The 'mounting the members page requires owner or admin' test performs its first Livewire assertion as a guest rather than as the employee, so the component-level employee 403 is only covered indirectly by another test and the test name overstates what it checks.
The invite e-mail is normalized twice in sendInvite and again by the EntityInvite mutator (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:36), which is redundant and obscures which layer owns normalization.
The rate-limit error reuses the auth.throttle login message ('Too many login attempts'), which is confusing in the invite form.

review.summary: This change implements invite-only entity membership end to end: table/model/factory, queued markdown mail, send/cancel/accept/decline flows, a manager-only members page with detail/save/remove modals, switcher and onboarding lists, lang keys, docs and a large Pest suite. The main path is complete and well tested, but confirmRemoval()/cancelRemoval() are unauthenticated, selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval are not #[Locked], saveRole() drops the membership-scoped assignRole policy, and the 'race' test never exercises the QueryException path, so the change needs fixes before merge.
